summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration_83 floating-UI fixes (S1.1, S1.1b, S1.2) on DynoPay marketing pages. With the language-onboarding-bar VISIBLE (localStorage cleared, logged out, --dp-lang-bar computed as 76px confirmed on every page), a NORMAL Playwright click on [data-testid=support-chat-button] after scrolling 900px succeeded and [data-testid=support-chat-panel] opened on /, /fees and /documentation at BOTH 1920x1080 and 390x844 — 6/6 PASS, no 'language-onboarding-bar intercepts pointer events' errors. document.elementFromPoint at the FAB centre resolved to the chat icon (ChatRoundedIcon) in all 6 cases, proving the FAB is now the topmost element at its hit area. S1.1b: scroll-to-top button sits fully ABOVE the FAB with zero geometric overlap (desktop 1856,868 40x40 vs FAB 1840,924 56x56; mobile 334,640 vs FAB 318,688) and its normal click succeeded on all 6 runs. S1.2 (mobile): during active scrolling the FAB does tuck off-screen/aria-hidden=true (intentional), but after ~2s at rest it returned to x=318,y=688 fully on-screen, aria-hidden=false, transform=none, opacity=1 and a normal click opened the panel on both / and /fees.

issues: Cosmetic only: the scroll-to-top up-arrow (bottom-right, ~y640) visually sits directly over the open chat panel's message-input/send-button row, so the arrow and the send icon appear stacked. It does not block the FAB click, but consider hiding the scroll-to-top button while the chat panel is open on mobile.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: hide/offset ScrollToTopButton while the mobile support-chat panel is open so it does not sit on the panel's send-button row.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportChatWidget FAB still uses zIndex 1451 which is BELOW the language bar's 1500; the fix works only because the FAB's bottom offset now clears the 76px bar via calc(var(--dp-lang-bar,0px) + base). If the bar's height ever changes without updating --dp-lang-bar (it is hardcoded to 76px in LanguageOnboardingBar), the interception regression returns. Safer to also raise the FAB zIndex above 1500.
ScrollToTopButton had no data-testid; I added data-testid="scroll-to-top-button" (test-scope change) so future automation can target it reliably.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 FAB click+panel open with lang bar visible; 6/6 scroll-to-top clickable & non-overlapping; 2/2 mobile at-rest reveal)

seed_data_creation: None — anonymous marketing pages, localStorage cleared before each load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: S1.1/S1.1b/S1.2 from iteration_83 are VERIFIED FIXED. Reproduction recipe: goto '/', localStorage.clear(), goto target path, wait_until='domcontentloaded' + 9s (networkidle never settles due to crypto ticker), assert [data-testid=language-onboarding-bar] visible and --dp-lang-bar == '76px', wheel 900px, wait 2.5s, then normal click [data-testid=support-chat-button]. Mobile FAB is intentionally aria-hidden while scrolling; always wait ~2s at rest before asserting. Added data-testid=scroll-to-top-button.
rca_of_the_issue: Original blocker: FAB zIndex 1451 < language bar zIndex 1500 AND the FAB's bottom offset ignored the 76px bar, so the bar covered the FAB hit area. Fix (bottom: calc(var(--dp-lang-bar,0px) + base) on both FAB and panel, plus mobile tuck limited to active scrolling with a 900ms idle reveal) verified effective; hit-testing now resolves to the chat icon.
